# Truco Arena — Product Overview

## Executive Summary
**Truco Arena** is a modern, high-fidelity competitive web application for Argentine Truco. It features 1v1 "Mano a Mano" matchplay (up to 30 points) with a Cyber-Billiard Green aesthetic system combined with traditional Argentine Fileteado Porteño flourishes and vector Spanish card graphics.

## Core Rules & Game Structure
- **Deck**: Baraja Española (40 cards: Espadas, Bastos, Oros, Copas; ranks 1..7, 10..12).
- **Match Target**: 30 Points (split into "Las Malas" 1..15 pts and "Las Buenas" 16..30 pts).
- **Hand Flow**:
  - Each player receives 3 cards.
  - 3 trick rounds (R1, R2, R3). First player to win 2 tricks wins the trick points.
  - Cantos: **Envido** (Envido, Real Envido, Falta Envido), **Flor** (if applicable), and **Truco** (Truco, Retruco, Vale Cuatro).
